purpose: Public portfolio fixture draft that documents how a high-value dependency impact scenario should be shaped before it becomes a regression dataset.

validationChecklist.label: Fixture shape
validationChecklist.note: 6 assets, 4 impact paths, 8 path steps, and 9 matrix cells exercise downstream fan-out.

validationChecklist.label: Receipt wiring
validationChecklist.note: Every path step and matrix cell points at an owner receipt.

validationChecklist.label: Publish pressure
validationChecklist.note: 3 held or rollback targets and 3 pending receipts keep the gate in Review.

validationChecklist.label: Public boundary
validationChecklist.note: Synthetic ids and relative public paths only.

validationChecklist.label: Owner review
validationChecklist.note: Real production fixtures still need TA owner acceptance before regression promotion.

guardrails: Keep source asset ids synthetic; do not encode project, depot, or DCC scene paths.
Every Review gate must explain the owner-visible decision, not just a numeric failure.
AI text can summarize the fixture, but gate, receipt state, and publish action must come from deterministic rows.
A scenario is not high-value until it exercises downstream fan-out and at least one held publish target.
